payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over all interior holds to remove; for each, compute new max adjacent difference as max(original global max if not affected, the merged gap) and track minimum.
payload.rationale: Exhaustive enumeration of removal candidates with O(1) update. No recursion/backtracking but closest among given subtypes. Other search subtypes (bitmask, B&B, DFS, permutations) are clearly inapplicable.
